mentions.name: Bürgeramt appointment finder
mentions.description: This web tool helps people find available Bürgeramt (citizen's office) appointments in Berlin. It was recently updated to work again after the city of Berlin changed its anti-bot measures.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have made a Bürgeramt appointment finder. It was down for a few weeks after the city of Berlin changed its anti-bot measures. I just released an updated version that works again: https://allaboutberlin.com/tools/appointment-finder
